suppressed.confidence: high on root cause; RECALL FLAG on rationale coverage

priorWontFixDisclosure.L-22: Owner triage 2026-10-01: intended by design. Owner: "That's the nature of tolerance. We're literally tolerating an attack of this size." The keeper-chosen tolerance t is the accepted MEV budget; per-zap extraction is bounded at ~0.44*t*Delta (ECON-001) on protocol-owned liquidity only, no user funds. Disposition does NOT cover sibling L-06 (342075dfba, BalancerPoolerV2.pool), which stays open, nor L-23 (shared-venue floor staleness), whose stale-floor mechanism could widen the effective tolerance beyond t.
priorWontFixDisclosure.L-23: Owner triage 2026-10-01: wont-fix. Owner: "The frequency of NFT minting is not live trading. This scenario is a lightning strike rather than a common inconvenience." Basis: the coupling only bites when UniPoolerV2.pool and PromotionUniV2_Eth Leg A land in the same block on stale quotes; at NFT-mint cadence that collision is rare, and extraction stays tolerance-bounded and POL-only (same tier as L-15 e64f73d629, L-06 342075dfba, L-22 ycn20l22, all wont-fix). Operational guidance retained: do not batch both calls in one block; quote the second after the first is mined. Revisit if dispatch cadence rises toward continuous/keeper-batched trading.

suppressed.whyNotRefiled: Same root cause (keeper-supplied spot floors, 0/0 addLiquidity mins, no TWAP). The swap-based quote-poisoning lever predates 267660b; the new donation lever (sync()/balanceOf-based quotePool) is dominated by it (a donation is a pure loss to the donor/LPs, or skimmable across a block boundary). No higher ceiling than the tolerance bound the owner accepted under L-22.
suppressed.recallFlag: ECON-21-003: L-23's 'lightning strike' rationale addresses ACCIDENTAL same-block floor staleness at NFT-mint cadence; it does not explicitly address an attacker who DELIBERATELY poisons the keeper's quote (by swap pre-fix and post-fix; by donation, newly in 267660b). L-22's tolerance rationale arguably covers the deliberate case (extraction stays <= keeper tolerance t), so the extraction ceiling is unchanged, but neither triageReason says so. NOT silently dropped: parked in manual-review.json as MR21-07 for the owner to confirm L-22/L-23's rationale covers deliberate poisoning. No status change proposed.
suppressed.operationalGuidance: Operational only. The keeper should check that pair.balanceOf equals getReserves() when it quotes (no pending donation), and should bound its floors against an off-chain reference such as PhusdStableMinter's $1 mint price, not spot alone. No code change.

priorWontFixDisclosure.L-24: Owner triage 2026-10-01: wont-fix. Owner: "This is a mild inconvenience at most." Basis: a third-party dust pre-seed only trips the cutover's fail-loud reserves==(0,0) precondition, so the impact is delay on a one-off cutover; the griefer gains nothing and the skew is cheaply and profitably arbitraged back. Safe-recovery guidance retained (footgun): if the pair is pre-seeded, arbitrage it to the target ratio, then seed via direct transfer + pair.mint with a reserve-ratio assertion. Never relax the precondition or router-addLiquidity with zero mins into a skewed pair. Does not cover Q-19 ycn20q19 (pair not bound to router factory), which is triaged separately.

Q-19.triageReason: Owner triage 2026-10-01: fix-pending. Not a duplicate of L-24 ycn20l24 (shared title from the DEDUP-20-04 split; L-24 is third-party dust pre-seed of the canonical pair, this is a non-canonical pair_ accepted at deploy). Fix plan (owner-confirmed): in the UniPoolerV2 constructor, require(IUniswapV2Factory(IUniswapV2Router02(router_).factory()).getPair(sUSDS_, phUSD_) == pair_).

L-24.triageReason: Owner triage 2026-10-01: wont-fix. Owner: "This is a mild inconvenience at most." Basis: a third-party dust pre-seed only trips the cutover's fail-loud reserves==(0,0) precondition, so the impact is delay on a one-off cutover; the griefer gains nothing and the skew is cheaply and profitably arbitraged back. Safe-recovery guidance retained (footgun): if the pair is pre-seeded, arbitrage it to the target ratio, then seed via direct transfer + pair.mint with a reserve-ratio assertion. Never relax the precondition or router-addLiquidity with zero mins into a skewed pair. Does not cover Q-19 ycn20q19 (pair not bound to router factory), which is triaged separately.

scopeResolutionQ19vsL24.ruling: The canonical-pair fix closes Q-19 (098396142d), not L-24. Both entries are halves of one run-20 dedup group (DEDUP-20-04) split by rootCauseClass and carry the parent's combined title verbatim, which is why the titles are identical and why L-24's title still mentions the canonical half. The authoritative scope is the rootCauseClass + owner triageReason, not the inherited title: L-24's triageReason scopes it to 'a third-party dust pre-seed' of the canonical pair and explicitly says it 'Does not cover Q-19 ycn20q19 (pair not bound to router factory)'; Q-19's triageReason says it is 'Not a duplicate of L-24' and its owner-confirmed fix plan is exactly the getPair check that landed at UniPoolerV2.sol:220-221. Faithfulness's reading ('L-24 includes the canonical half') follows the title only and is overruled by both triageReasons. The dust pre-seed half (L-24) is untouched by 267660b and remains wont-fix; no change to L-24's status is proposed. Optional human-only cosmetic action: retitle Q-19/L-24 to their facets to remove the shared-title hazard.
